Questions

Before you buy

What outlet does the Fuji need?

It runs on a dedicated 120V / 20A outlet. Check this against your room before ordering.

How is the Fuji delivered and assembled?

Shipping is free. In-stock orders take two to four business days to process, then three to seven in transit, and the cabin goes together with a clasp-together assembly.

What's covered under warranty?

7-year residential warranty; full terms by component are published on the warranty page.

How hot does the Fuji get?

The cabin heats up to 150°F using full-spectrum infrared across near, mid, and far wavelengths.

Can I return it if it doesn't fit my space?

Returns require the sauna disassembled and repacked in its original crate, with a restocking fee and return shipping paid by the customer.
